script: python eval.py --ckpt runs/full2/final_ema.pt --name full2_n64 --device cuda --episodes 64 --long 512 --n-val 256 --bank 20000 --steps 2 --init unit --ctx-sigma 0.05

per_episode_frames_until_below_25db.definition: first frame whose 5-frame window averages below 25 dB, per episode; never = horizon + 1

per_episode_frames_until_below_20db.definition: first frame whose 5-frame window averages below 20 dB, per episode; never = horizon + 1

validity_nearest_real_frame_psnr.note: PSNR of each frame to its nearest neighbour among 20000 real frames; real = the true game frames of the same episodes

figure_curves.note: per-frame curves behind media/drift.png (tools/render_drift.mjs); frame 1 = first dreamed frame
